verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents all three parts of the story: bill capture through 'smart invoice scanning technology', 'automate invoice payments and approval flows', and paying vendors in bulk with scheduling and invoice audit trails. The MCP server can also 'review bill pay invoices, manage vendors.' The approval workflow, which is the core of the story, rests on a single marketing line with no detail on how bills are routed, so it earns partial credit. Missing for 10: documentation of approval routing (approvers, multi-level or conditional rules, an approve-before-pay gate), explicit bill upload flow beyond 'invoice scanning', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
